blurb_text: The New York Yankees' home game against the Chicago White Sox was postponed because of hazardous air quality in New York caused by smoke from Canadian wildfires.

The Washington Nationals' home game against the Arizona Diamondbacks was postponed because of smoke and haze in Washington from the Canadian wildfires.

The Los Angeles Angels' game against the Cincinnati Reds scheduled for Monday night has been postponed due to the effects of Tropical Storm Hilary. The game will be made up as part of a doubleheader Wednesday.

blurb_text: The Miami Marlins' game against the New York Mets was postponed due to unplayable field conditions, with the Citi Field playing surface left soaked by the weekend's heavy rain.
The New York Mets' season opener against the Milwaukee Brewers was postponed because of rain in the forecast and rescheduled for Friday, March 29.
The Detroit Tigers' game against the New York Mets at Citi Field was postponed because of rain.
The Tigers and Mets were postponed for a second straight day because of rain; the clubs will play a doubleheader Thursday.
The Minnesota Twins' home game against the Oakland Athletics was postponed because of inclement weather in Minneapolis.
The final two games of a crucial series between the New York Mets and Atlanta Braves were postponed by heavy rains ahead of Hurricane Helene. The games will be made up as a doubleheader on Monday.
Thursday's game between the New York Mets and Atlanta Braves was postponed because of the approaching Hurricane Helene; MLB plans to make up both games as part of a doubleheader Monday.
Monday's game between the Cleveland Guardians and the Washington Nationals was postponed because of inclement weather in Washington.
The Baltimore Orioles' home game Tuesday against the Minnesota Twins was postponed due to inclement weather. Instead, the teams will play a traditional doubleheader Wednesday.
Tuesday's game between the St. Louis Cardinals and the Philadelphia Phillies was postponed; the clubs will play a doubleheader on Wednesday.
Both of Tuesday's Guardians-Twins games - the resumption of Monday night's suspended game and the originally-scheduled 6:40 p.m. CT contest - have been postponed due to inclement weather.
The Philadelphia Phillies announced that the second game of the Braves-Phillies series has been postponed because of poor weather. The two teams will face each other in a doubleheader Thursday.

The New York Mets were awarded a 1-0 win over the Marlins in the game suspended by rain on Sept. 28, with Miami's two-run rally in the ninth voided because the inning was not completed. The game was never resumed, and the score reverted to 1-0 under the suspended-game rules.

The Blue Jays-Red Sox game at Fenway Park was suspended by rain in the top of the second inning and resumed two months later as part of an August 26 doubleheader, when Danny Jansen became the first player to appear for both teams in the same game.

The game between the Cleveland Guardians and the Minnesota Twins was suspended at the top of the fourth inning because of inclement weather Monday night in Minneapolis. Minnesota led 2-1 when play was suspended.
The Cincinnati Reds' game against the Boston Red Sox at Fenway Park was suspended because of rain and was scheduled to resume the following day in the fourth inning.
The Speedway Classic between the Atlanta Braves and Cincinnati Reds at Bristol Motor Speedway was suspended by rain in the first inning and resumed on Sunday.
Ahead of Hurricane Hilary, MLB moved Sunday's Marlins-Dodgers game up a day: the clubs played a doubleheader on Saturday instead of the originally scheduled Sunday game.
Ahead of Hurricane Hilary, the Angels' game scheduled for Sunday against Tampa Bay was moved up and played as part of a Saturday doubleheader.
Ahead of Hurricane Hilary, MLB rescheduled the Padres' Sunday home game against the Diamondbacks, playing it as part of a Saturday doubleheader instead.
The Yankees moved the start of their game against the Marlins from 2:05 p.m. to 6:05 p.m., a four-hour shift, because of the solar eclipse.

The Athletics beat the Texas Rangers 3-2 in their final game at the Oakland Coliseum before a sellout crowd of 46,889. The A's leave Oakland and will play the coming seasons in Sacramento ahead of a planned Las Vegas ballpark.

After Hurricane Milton tore the roof off Tropicana Field in October 2024, the Tampa Bay Rays moved their 2025 home games to George M. Steinbrenner Field in Tampa, opening the season there against the Colorado Rockies.
The NBA postponed the Wizards-Pistons game in Detroit because the Pistons were stuck in Dallas by an ice storm and could not travel home.
The NBA postponed Wednesday's Warriors game at the Jazz following the sudden death of Golden State assistant coach Dejan Milojevic, who suffered a heart attack at a team dinner in Salt Lake City.
The NBA has postponed Friday night's game between the Golden State Warriors and the Dallas Mavericks at Chase Center as the Warriors continue to grieve the death of assistant coach Dejan Milojevic.
The Los Angeles Lakers' game against the Charlotte Hornets on Thursday night at Crypto.com Arena was postponed due to the ongoing wildfires in the Los Angeles area.

The NBA has postponed two Saturday games - San Antonio Spurs-Los Angeles Lakers at Crypto.com Arena and Charlotte Hornets-LA Clippers at Intuit Dome - due to the ongoing wildfires in Southern California.
The NBA postponed Saturday's Charlotte Hornets-LA Clippers game at Intuit Dome due to the ongoing wildfires in Southern California; the rescheduled date will be announced at a later time.
The Houston Rockets' game against the Atlanta Hawks was postponed because of an ice and snow storm in Atlanta.
The Milwaukee Bucks' game against the New Orleans Pelicans was postponed because of a historic snowstorm in New Orleans.

The scheduled Saturday contest between the Golden State Warriors and Minnesota Timberwolves was postponed and pushed back to Sunday afternoon. The NBA said the decision was made to prioritize the safety and security of the Minneapolis community.
The Denver Nuggets' game against the Memphis Grizzlies was postponed because of Winter Storm Fern.
The Dallas Mavericks' game against the Milwaukee Bucks was postponed because of Winter Storm Fern; the Mavericks were unable to leave Dallas.
The Los Angeles Kings' home game against the Calgary Flames on Wednesday was postponed due to the ongoing wildfires in the Los Angeles area.
The NHL postponed the Buffalo Sabres' home game against the Chicago Blackhawks because of snow and local travel bans in Buffalo.
The Tampa Bay Lightning's home opener against the Carolina Hurricanes was postponed due to Hurricane Milton.
The Los Angeles Kings' game against the Columbus Blue Jackets was postponed because of severe winter weather in Columbus and rescheduled for March 9.
The Arizona Coyotes played their final game in Arizona, against the Edmonton Oilers, before the franchise's relocation to Utah, where it will play at Delta Center in Salt Lake City.
The Buffalo Bills' wild-card playoff game against the Pittsburgh Steelers was pushed from Sunday to Monday because of a lake-effect snowstorm in the Buffalo area.
The Buffalo Bills-Cincinnati Bengals game was suspended in the first quarter after Bills safety Damar Hamlin suffered cardiac arrest on the field; the game was later cancelled and never resumed.
